name: A travelling pedlar
line: Word is, a pedlar comes through tonight with a pack worth a look.
taken: The pedlar sets down the pack and lets you pick through it.

name: The lantern festival
line: Word is, lanterns are going up along the street tonight.
taken: Every lantern on the street is lit, and whatever you enchant tonight will glow for longer.

name: The harvest supper
line: Word is, long tables are going out in the lane tonight.
taken: The tables are long and the bread is warm. Tomorrow will feel it.

name: A travelling musician
line: Word is, someone is tuning a fiddle on the green tonight.
taken: The fiddle starts up, and the first person you call on is glad twice over.

name: A stargazer
line: Word is, a stranger has set a brass tube up on the hill tonight.
taken: The stranger lets you look, and says something useful about what you were nearly making.
